symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficients in the list, which equals the product of the distinct primes $p_1 \cdots p_k$.
symbols.quote: Let $N$ be the number of coefficients in the list, and write $N = p_1 p_2 \cdots p_k$ with $p_1, \dots, p_k$ distinct primes.

symbols.name: axis prime
symbols.meaning: One of the distinct primes $p_1, \dots, p_k$ whose product is $N$; each $p_j$ is the length of its cyclic axis.
symbols.quote: Let $N$ be the number of coefficients in the list, and write $N = p_1 p_2 \cdots p_k$ with $p_1, \dots, p_k$ distinct primes.

symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient in the list, taken in $\{0, \dots, N-1\}$.
symbols.quote: The index $i \in \{0, \dots, N-1\}$ of a coefficient is sent to the tuple of its residues $(i \bmod p_1, \dots, i \bmod p_k)$.

relations.quote: This map preserves [convolution](convolution.md) on the axes, so a cyclic product of two lists on $\mathbb{Z}_N$ becomes a product on the prime axes.
The map is applied to the radix-digit coefficient list produced by [reduction of integer product to digit convolution](radix-digit-reduction.md).
The map's axis moves are costed in the [fixed-tape machine model and stream operations](fixed-tape-model.md).
